en.headline: Woman dies after being found in the sea off Sheung Wan
en.dek: Firefighters rescued a woman in her 50s or 60s from the water near the Rumsey Street car park early on Wednesday; she was unconscious and later died in hospital.
body: Police received a report at about 2am on Wednesday that a person was floating in the sea about 30 metres off the Rumsey Street car park in Sheung Wan. A fireboat crew recovered a woman who was unconscious.

She was taken to the Central Government Pier and then by ambulance to Ruttonjee Hospital, where she was confirmed dead. The woman was estimated to be in her 50s or 60s and carried no identity documents; police found no note at the scene.
Police are investigating the circumstances. The cause of death is subject to post-mortem examination.

zh.headline: 上環女子墮海獲救不治 警方調查
zh.dek: 周三凌晨約2時，上環林士街停車場對開海面有女子載浮載沉，消防救起後昏迷送院，最終不治。
body: 警方於周三凌晨約2時接獲途人報案，指上環林士街停車場對開約30米海面有人漂浮。消防小艇到場將一名女子救起，當時已昏迷。
女子被送往中區政府碼頭再轉送律敦治醫院搶救，最終不治。據了解，女事主年約50至60歲，身上沒有身份證明文件，現場未檢獲遺書。
警方正調查事件起因，死因有待驗屍確定。
